decoy: src/lib/mission-arc.ts → outboundArc (same file, older function used only by /explore overlay, not the primary /fly arc path)
rationale: transferEllipse computes the arc shape with a = (r1+r2)/2 — the Hohmann semi-major axis which assumes departure and arrival at opposite apsides. For missions where Earth at dep_day and the destination at flyby_day sit at angular separations far from 180°, the resulting ellipse has incorrect eccentricity (approaching e≈1 in near-conjunction configurations), distending the middle of the arc while still correctly pinning both endpoints. The failed patch likely mistook outboundArc — a look-alike function in the same file that only serves the /explore overlay — for the true owner of the fly-page rendering path.
